title: Twinter
tagline: The idea of this app is that people can paste their own twitter profile, image they want to convert to NFT that they want their followers to get, and go.
description: The idea of this app is that people can paste their own twitter profile, image they want to convert to NFT that they want their followers to get, and go. The steps are basically: Paste your twitter profile username. Upload the image you want to convert to NFT. Set the limit of minting (1-N). Wait for someone to follow you. They receive that image as an NFT when they follow you.
how_its_made: Using moralis to get the user connected to the app. Will use twitter to get their twitter access to watch follow event. Also, thought of using polygon to mint NFT. The features might not be complete at the time of submission as everything is new to me but this will be work in progress using these 2 tech - Moralis and Polygon.
